note: Machine-readable companion (P0-W2). Every INVARIANTS.md invariant carries an id, a one-line statement, an expressibility status, and — where machine-checkable — the automation that checks it today. 'documented-not-expressible' means no honest static/runtime check exists in the repository yet; these become machine-checked in later Work Orders as the financial/trust/capability layers land.

invariants.statement: One Financial Protocol Authority.
invariants.notes: No financial-layer packages exist yet at base e40f2b9; the single-authority property becomes machine-checkable once financial packages exist (ownership validator would flag any second financial_truth owner). Partial guard today: MODULE-OWNERSHIP authority.financial_truth=financial is linted for existence (invariant-lint:C).

invariants.statement: Exact/lossless monetary representation only.
invariants.notes: Requires financial-domain type analysis; no money types exist yet at base e40f2b9.

invariants.statement: Historical financial facts are immutable and versioned.
invariants.notes: Needs financial persistence layer; nothing to check yet at base e40f2b9.

invariants.statement: UNKNOWN is distinct from FAILED and is reconciled rather than blindly retried.
invariants.notes: Runtime state-machine semantics; requires P1-W2 financial protocol state machines.

invariants.statement: Every consequential financial effect has authorization lineage and evidence lineage.
invariants.notes: Requires effect-commit machinery; nothing financial exists at base e40f2b9.

invariants.statement: State-changing commands are idempotent and replay-safe.
invariants.notes: Runtime semantics, not statically decidable; future invariant suite territory (P1).

invariants.statement: External provider/wallet balances are observations, not PaySwap custody.
invariants.notes: Requires capability observation model (P2); no provider-balance ingestion exists yet.

invariants.statement: PaySwap has no unilateral withdrawal authority over user/provider funds.
invariants.notes: Non-custody property over future signing/withdrawal paths; no such code exists yet.

invariants.statement: Agents, LLMs, Lab, optimizers and simulations cannot declare financial truth.
invariants.notes: Becomes machine-checkable when intelligence-layer packages import financial-truth APIs (ownership validator: intelligence may_depend_on excludes financial). Layer rules already encode it for future packages; no intelligence packages exist yet.

invariants.statement: Opportunity/discovery output cannot directly authorize execution.
invariants.notes: Same future-mapping as INV-9 (P6-W2 FinancialOpportunity consumers).

invariants.statement: Simulation is never production financial authority.
invariants.notes: Lab runtime separation arrives with P6-W1; policy booleans linted (invariant-lint:C).

invariants.statement: Child delegation is strictly attenuated.
invariants.notes: Trust-layer delegation semantics (P1-W3); no trust packages exist yet.

invariants.statement: Provider catalogue capability is not executable connected capability.
invariants.notes: Capability-model runtime distinction (P2); catalogue types not yet present.

invariants.statement: Provider state is preserved where needed for action/reconciliation/audit.
invariants.notes: Provider-state envelope semantics (P2-W1).

invariants.statement: Provider-native execution remains a candidate baseline.
invariants.notes: Route-compiler policy property (P5-W1).

invariants.statement: Provider implementations do not leak into provider-neutral domain contracts.
invariants.notes: The contracts-layer packages (shared, cli/contracts, cli/shared-types) are checked for framework/runtime imports and every cross-layer edge is checked against may_depend_on. Provider-specific packages are platform-layer, so contracts->platform edges already FAIL the baseline (R3), which is the honest enforcement of this boundary.

invariants.statement: Blockchain is one settlement rail family, not a parallel financial system.
invariants.notes: Becomes checkable when rails-layer packages exist (no separate financial ledger authority per chain). current-state policy blockchain_is_one_rail_family=true is linted for doc consistency (invariant-lint:C).

invariants.statement: Supported onchain writes follow prepare -> simulate -> security -> diff -> authorize -> recheck -> execute -> observe/finality -> reconcile.
invariants.notes: Requires onchain write machinery (P4); sequence enforcement is a runtime invariant suite task.

invariants.statement: Raw private keys, seed phrases, passwords, MFA material, API secrets and protected session cookies never enter model context or ordinary artifacts.
invariants.notes: Secret-boundary enforcement needs credential broker (P2-W2) + adversarial tests (P8-W2). Static grep-style heuristics were considered and rejected as dishonest (false positives/negatives); documented instead.

invariants.statement: Generic contract writes never execute silently without sufficient identity, semantics, security and authority.
invariants.notes: Onchain write authorization semantics (P4-W2).

invariants.statement: Security/adversarial intelligence cannot downgrade BLOCK.
invariants.notes: Deterministic gate semantics (P1-W3/P6-W3); policy boolean security_block_cannot_be_downgraded linted for doc consistency (invariant-lint:C).

invariants.statement: Web/Desktop/Mobile/Extension/SDK/API share framework-independent PaySwap Surface contracts.
invariants.notes: Surface contracts are P2-W3/P7 deliverables; once experience packages exist, ownership validator enforces experience->contracts-only edges. Policy boolean surface_contracts_are_framework_independent linted (invariant-lint:C).

invariants.statement: UI never owns financial truth.
invariants.notes: Encoded in layer rules (experience must_not_own_financial_truth; financial must_not_depend_on ui); fully machine-checkable once experience/financial packages exist. Partial guard: financial layer rule presence linted (invariant-lint:D).

invariants.statement: No dead financial actions, fake success states or fabricated provider effects.
invariants.notes: Requires UI + capability integration tests (P7/P8); inherently behavioral.

invariants.statement: Test/sandbox/live/mainnet distinctions are explicit and mechanically enforced.
invariants.notes: Environment-mode enforcement machinery arrives with provider runtime (P2-W2).

invariants.statement: No circular package dependencies.
invariants.notes: Package-level cycle detection over the real import graph. Baseline: 0 cycles.

invariants.statement: Domain contracts do not import UI/framework/runtime implementation details.
invariants.notes: Framework-freedom check for every contracts-layer package. Baseline: 0 violations.

invariants.statement: Work Orders are pairwise-disjoint.
invariants.notes: Organizational process constraint; write-surface disjointness is verified by the TL at acceptance (repo-history inspection), not by a static tree check.

invariants.statement: Frozen architecture changes require ADR + dependency-graph + state updates.
invariants.notes: Process constraint on governance workflow; partially witnessed by git history and spec/adr/, not statically checkable in-tree.
